goal: Measure and enforce the silent reviewer reclaim request budget without weakening its safety proofs.
prohibited_actions: Do not widen the shared review-operation request limit
Do not remove the in-mutex safety re-proof
Do not author or apply a database migration
Do not weaken or bypass a required check
assumptions: The operation-specific ceiling is derived from wire-attempt fixtures
Current and legacy lease-key routes retain their in-mutex safety proof
This repository-maintenance change touches no database object
stop_conditions: A required check proves a defect
Completion would require weakening a safety guard
The pull request base moves again before merge
